verdict.rationale: Mastra's docs describe memory as storing and recalling message history (mastra-docs-4,17,22,48,54) and generic 'processors' that transform/control messages (mastra-docs-33), but none of the evidence describes trimming, summarizing, or filtering conversation history specifically to fit within a context window. Missing for 10: explicit context-window management features (e.g., truncation strategies, summarization of old messages, token-budget controls) and any documentation or community confirmation that such trimming/summarization exists.
